attributes.name: pull quote markup structure
attributes.definition: The HTML elements used to mark up quotations or pull quotes on the page.

values.definition: Quotes wrapped in figure with blockquote and figcaption, no cite element.
Quotes use a plain blockquote without figure/figcaption wrapping.
Different markup or no quotes present.

attributes.name: pull quote typography
attributes.definition: The font style and family applied to pull quote text.

values.definition: Quote text set in italic serif type.

attributes.name: pull quote border accent
attributes.definition: Presence and placement of a border or rule accent on quote blocks.

values.definition: A coloured vertical border on the left side of the quote.
Other accent such as quote marks, top rule or background.
